entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 3423693395726613504: position at J2016.0. Distance: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, RZ Gem: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 1990.3 +/- 193.9 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 1990.3 +/- 193.9 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 0.2487 +/- 0.0538 mas (same row, RUWE 2.99), 4.6 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -0.780, -1.281 mas/yr. Radial velocity from SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 3423693395726613504 (quality E), from 1953GCRV..C......0W; Gaia DR3 measures none.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 39.2 +/- 3.8 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, RZ Gem: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 39.2 +/- 3.8 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5750 +/- 412 K from Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 145, Name='RZ Gem', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 5750 +/- 412 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic).

entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 5,750 K, because interstellar dust reddens every spectrum of this star, E(B-V) = 0.563 +/- 0.025 (Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10), and its light changes through each pulsation, through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #fff0e9. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: skipped; gaia-xp: skipped; pulkovo: skipped; kiehling: skipped; kharitonov: skipped; burnashev: skipped; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,750 K and log g 2.2 (u1 0.450, u2 0.257): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.

entries.subject: Surface gravity
entries.finding: Published: log g 2.2 from 2013MNRAS.428.3252A; the 5 published values span log g 1.73 to 2.36, across which the limb law changes by at most 0.4% of the centre brightness.

entries.subject: Light curve
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 vari_cepheid, source 3423693395726613504: 2 G-band harmonics of a 5.529742728667394 d period, peak-to-peak 0.758 mag; the harmonics reproduce the row's epoch of maximum and peak-to-peak amplitude. The page plays it as a veil over the disc from the scene date, phase known to 0.09 of a cycle there.
